metadata.description: The Chhattisgarh high court has reversed 2012 decision of the state government to increase ST reservation from 20 percent to 30 percent. The state government had decided to increase the ST quote in proportion of the tribal population of the state. High court has based it's judgment on the ceiling fixed on the reservation by Supreme Court. The opposition party BJP is blaming the state government for not defending the reservation of adivasis in the court.
